SELECT O. ID AS RECORDID, O.STAFF_BADGE, O.STAFF_NAME, STAFF.COMP_NAME, STAFF.DEP_NAME, STAFF.JOB_NAME, O.PROCESS_ID, O.CREATE_TIME AS RECORDDATE, O.WORK_TIME AS EXTRAWORKDATE, O.WORK_TYPE, O.DURATION AS EXTRAWORKCOUNT, O.CAUSE, O.WORK_CLASS_CODE AS workClassCode, O.CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_OVERTIME_APPLICATION O INNER JOIN SMT_STAFF STAFF ON O.STAFF_BADGE=STAFF.BADGE
O.STAFF_BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffBadge}),'%')
AND O.STAFF_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffName}),'%')
AND O.CREATE_TIME between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
AND STAFF.COMP_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SPB.COMP_ID from SMT_PARK_BU SPB
SPB.PARK_ID IN
#{id}
)
ORDER BY O.CREATE_TIME DESC
